display.title: Achdus Before Shiva Asar B'Tammuz: Why We March Together
display.summary_short: Why the weekly Hakochainik march matters: it brings simcha and achdus, which are needed most before the fast of the seventeenth of Tammuz.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, recorded the week of Shiva Asar B'Tammuz. Uncle Yossi gives two reasons for the weekly Hakochainik march: it makes us happy, and it is a mitzvah to serve Hashem with joy; and it has us doing things together, which is achdus, so precious to Hashem. Now in the month of Tammuz, with the seventeenth of Tammuz falling on Shabbos that year so the fast is moved to Sunday, he explains that the sad events of that day happened because the Jewish people lacked unity and Ahavas Yisroel. Doing things together, especially now, strengthens our achdus and brings Moshiach closer.
display.lesson: Doing good things together with joy builds achdus, and achdus brings Moshiach closer.
